item.name: Create an exchange for an account

request.description:
Create an exchange for an account. The request body will vary based on the exchange partner.
For Finicity, the request body will include finicity-specific fields.
For MX Secure Exchange, the request body will include a token.
For Flinks Secure Exchange, the request body will include a token.
For Plaid Secure Exchange, the request body will include a token.

request.description: Creates an exchange connection between a customer and Dwolla. Request body varies by partner (Plaid, MX, Flinks, Finicity, Checkout.com). For bank accounts, use Plaid, MX, Flinks, or Finicity to establish secure access to the customer's bank account data. For debit cards (Push to Card), use Checkout.com and pass the payment ID from Checkout.com Flow.
